title: Agent 工具链开始分层：上下文、技能与桌面操控
opening: 今天榜单几乎被 Agent 基础设施占满，但真正值得多看一眼的是 NVIDIA/auto-ontology 和 vercel-labs/agent-desktop：前者试图给 Agent 补上企业数据的语义层，后者干脆绕开截图，用操作系统无障碍树让 Agent 操作桌面应用。

projects.name: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
projects.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
projects.readmeExcerpt: Auto Ontology Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar. NVIDIA Auto Ontology is an open library that builds that layer from enterprise metadata, reconciles definitions across systems, and exposes it to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. It complements the semantic models customers already own. It enables developers to: - Discover: generate enterprise ontologies from metadata; connect existing ontologies and semantic models; build AI-ready knowledge graphs. - Ground: give agents trusted business meaning for metrics, entities, and relationships; reconcile inconsistent definitions across systems. - Validate: check generated queries against certified definitions and lineage; return provenance with every answer. - Expose: serve context to any agent harness through MCP, CLI, and API. Learn: fold certified corrections and usage back into the ontology, so shared context improves with every question. Benchmark
projects.summary: 从企业元数据生成本体，给 Agent 提供可校验、带来源的业务语义上下文层。
projects.problem: Agent 查数据库不难，难的是保证“营收”这类指标在不同系统里定义一致且可追溯。它通过 MCP、CLI 和 API 把本体暴露给任意 Agent 框架，并校验生成查询是否符合已认证定义。局限在于效果高度依赖企业元数据质量。

projects.name: D4Vinci/Scrapling
projects.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
projects.readmeExcerpt: Effortless Web Scraping for the Modern Web Selection methods · Fetchers · Spiders · Proxy Rotation · CLI · MCP Scrapling is a Python Web Scraping framework that brings fast HTTP requests, stealth browsers, powerful parsing, and concurrent crawling into one library. Scrape static pages, render JavaScript, interact with websites, and extract data from the API calls behind them. Build crawlers with reusable sessions, proxy rotation, automatic retries, pause/resume, and built-in data exports. Use it from Python, the terminal, or your AI agent through its MCP server and Agent Skill. From extracting a few fields to collecting a whole website as clean Markdown, Scrapling covers the full scraping workflow. What you can do with Scrapling - **Fetch & interact**: Fast HTTP requests, stealth browsers, JavaScript rendering, Cloudflare Turnstile/Interstitial handling, persistent sessions, and background API capture. - **Parse & extract**: CSS, XPath, text and regex search, adaptive element tracking, similar-element matching, and clean Markdown output. - **Crawl & export**: Concurrent spiders, proxy rotation, retries, AutoThrottle, pause/resume, streaming, ready

projects.name: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
projects.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
projects.readmeExcerpt: agent-desktop Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree. agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library. Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads. Install Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64. For direct execution without a JavaScript launcher, download the matching native archive from GitHub Releases and keep its helper beside the executable. On macOS and Linux, Homebrew also works: `brew install agent-desktop`. There is no official Scoop package yet. The repository no longer maintains a custom Homebrew tap or Scoop bucket. Release archives and building from source are cov

projects.name: lz4/lz4
projects.readmeExcerpt: LZ4 - Extremely fast compression ================================ LZ4 is a lossless compression algorithm, providing compression speed > 500 MB/s per core, scalable with multi-core CPUs. It features an extremely fast decoder, with speed in multiple GB/s per core, typically reaching RAM speed limits on multi-core systems. Compression speed can be tuned dynamically, by selecting an "acceleration" factor which trades compression ratio for faster speed. On the other end, a high compression derivative, LZ4_HC, is also provided, trading CPU time for improved compression ratio. All versions feature the same decompression speed. LZ4 is also compatible with dictionary compression, both at API and CLI (`-D`) levels. It can ingest any input file as dictionary, though only the final 64 KB are used. This capability can be combined with the Zstandard Dictionary Builder, in order to drastically improve compression performance on small files. The LZ4 library is provided as open-source software using the BSD 2-Clause license. The `lz4` command line utility is provided under the GPL-2.0-or-later license. Benchmarks The benchmark uses [lzbench] v2.4.1, from @inikep compiled with GCC v13.3.0 on Linux
projects.summary: 老牌极速压缩算法，压缩每秒超过 500 MB，解压能跑到内存带宽。
projects.problem: 提供可调加速因子在压缩率和速度之间取舍，另有 LZ4_HC 高压缩版本，解压速度不变。支持字典压缩，适合小文件场景。它不是新项目，出现在榜单里更像基础设施的日常存在感。

projects.name: vercel-labs/agent-browser
projects.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
projects.readmeExcerpt: agent-browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. `snapshot` returns the page as compact text with a ref such as `@e1` for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. Install - **Homebrew:** `brew install agent-browser`, then `agent-browser install`. - **Linux:** `agent-browser install --with-deps` also installs the browser's system libraries. - **No install:** `npx agent-browser open example.com`. Project installs, building from source, `upgrade`, and `doctor` are covered in Installation. Quick start The snapshot for `example.com`: - Refs describe the page at the time of the snapshot. After navigation or a DOM change, take a new snapshot before using refs again. - CSS selectors, text, XPath, and semantic locators also work, for example `agent-browser find role button click --name "Submit"`. See Selectors. - A click fails, instead of reporting success, when the target is h
projects.summary: Rust 写的浏览器自动化 CLI，把页面读成带 ref 的无障碍树，让 Agent 一步步操作。
projects.problem: 浏览器在命令之间保持打开，每次操作就是一次短 shell 调用，snapshot 返回紧凑文本和元素引用。支持 CSS、文本、XPath 和语义定位。和 agent-desktop 思路同源，但专注浏览器；页面变化后必须重新 snapshot 才能继续用 ref。

closing: Agent 竞争正从模型转向上下文和操作层：谁能把企业语义、桌面 UI、浏览器和 Git 工作流变成 Agent 可靠可校验的接口，谁就掌握下一段工程体验。
